role.documentation: Commission file number. The field allows up to 17 characters. The prefix may contain 1-3 digits, the sequence number may contain 1-8 digits, the optional suffix may contain 1-4 characters, and the fields are separated with a hyphen.

role.label: Entity Filer Category
role.documentation: Indicate whether the registrant is one of the following: Large Accelerated Filer, Accelerated Filer, Non-accelerated Filer. Definitions of these categories are stated in Rule 12b-2 of the Exchange Act. This information should be based on the registrant's current or most recent filing containing the related disclosure.

role.terseLabel: Entity Incorporation, State or Country Code
role.label: Entity Incorporation, State or Country Code
role.documentation: Two-character EDGAR code representing the state or country of incorporation.

role.label: Entity Information [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.label: Entity Interactive Data Current
role.documentation: Boolean flag that is true when the registrant has submitted electronically every Interactive Data File required to be submitted pursuant to Rule 405 of Regulation S-T during the preceding 12 months (or for such shorter period that the registrant was required to submit such files).

role.label: Entity Public Float
role.documentation: The aggregate market value of the voting and non-voting common equity held by non-affiliates computed by reference to the price at which the common equity was last sold, or the average bid and asked price of such common equity, as of the last business day of the registrant's most recently completed second fiscal quarter.

role.label: Entity Registrant Name
role.documentation: The exact name of the entity filing the report as specified in its charter, which is required by forms filed with the SEC.

role.label: Entity Shell Company
role.documentation: Boolean flag that is true when the registrant is a shell company as defined in Rule 12b-2 of the Exchange Act.

role.label: Entity Small Business
role.documentation: Indicates that the company is a Smaller Reporting Company (SRC).

role.label: Entity Tax Identification Number
role.documentation: The Tax Identification Number (TIN), also known as an Employer Identification Number (EIN), is a unique 9-digit value assigned by the IRS.

role.label: Entity Voluntary Filers
role.documentation: Indicate 'Yes' or 'No' if the registrant is not required to file reports pursuant to Section 13 or Section 15(d) of the Act.

role.label: Entity Well-known Seasoned Issuer
role.documentation: Indicate 'Yes' or 'No' if the registrant is a well-known seasoned issuer, as defined in Rule 405 of the Securities Act. Is used on Form Type: 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 20-F, 6-K, 10-K/A, 10-Q/A, 20-F/A, 6-K/A, N-CSR, N-Q, N-1A.

role.terseLabel: Equity Awards Adjustments, Excluding Value Reported in Compensation Table
role.label: Equity Awards Adjustments, Excluding Value Reported in the Compensation Table [Member]

role.terseLabel: Aggregate Grant Date Fair Value of Equity Award Amounts Reported in Summary Compensation Table
role.label: Aggregate Grant Date Fair Value of Equity Award Amounts Reported in Summary Compensation Table [Member]
Equity Component [Domain]
role.documentation: Components of equity are the parts of the total Equity balance including that which is allocated to common, preferred, treasury stock, retained earnings, etc.

role.label: Investment, Name [Domain]
role.documentation: Name of investment including named security. Excludes entity that is consolidated.

role.label: Equity Method Investment, Ownership Percentage
role.documentation: The percentage of ownership of common stock or equity participation in the investee accounted for under the equity method of accounting.

role.label: Equity Method Investments
role.documentation: This item represents the carrying amount on the entity's balance sheet of its investment in common stock of an equity method investee. This is not an indicator of the fair value of the investment, rather it is the initial cost adjusted for the entity's share of earnings and losses of the investee, adjusted for any distributions (dividends) and other than temporary impairment (OTTI) losses recognized.

role.label: Equity Method Investments [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for equity method of accounting for investments and other interests. Investment includes, but is not limited to, unconsolidated subsidiary, corporate joint venture, noncontrolling interest in real estate venture, limited partnership, and limited liability company. Information includes, but is not limited to, ownership percentage, reason equity method is or is not considered appropriate, and accounting policy election for distribution received.

role.terseLabel: Increase to equity in non-controlling interest
role.label: Equity Reclassified To Entity From Noncontrolling Interest
role.documentation: Amount of increase to equity reclassified to the entity from non-controlling interest representing additional CW units acquired.

role.label: Equity Valuation Assumption Difference, Footnote [Text Block]

role.terseLabel: Fair Value Measurement Inputs and Valuation Techniques [Line Items]
role.label: Fair Value Measurement Inputs and Valuation Techniques [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.terseLabel: Fair Value Measurement Inputs and Valuation Techniques [Table]
role.label: Fair Value Measurement Inputs and Valuation Techniques [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about input and valuation technique used to measure fair value and change in valuation approach and technique for each separate class of asset and liability measured on recurring and nonrecurring basis.

role.terseLabel: Summary of Significant Assumptions to Determine Fair Value
role.label: Fair Value Measurement Inputs and Valuation Techniques [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of input and valuation technique used to measure fair value and change in valuation approach and technique for each separate class of asset and liability measured on recurring and nonrecurring basis.

role.label: Fair Value Hierarchy and NAV [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by level within fair value hierarchy and fair value measured at net asset value per share as practical expedient.

role.label: Fair Value Disclosures [Text Block]
role.documentation: The entire disclosure for the fair value of financial instruments (as defined), including financial assets and financial liabilities (collectively, as defined), and the measurements of those instruments as well as disclosures related to the fair value of non-financial assets and liabilities. Such disclosures about the financial instruments, assets, and liabilities would include: (1) the fair value of the required items together with their carrying amounts (as appropriate); (2) for items for which it is not practicable to estimate fair value, disclosure would include: (a) information pertinent to estimating fair value (including, carrying amount, effective interest rate, and maturity, and (b) the reasons why it is not practicable to estimate fair value; (3) significant concentrations of credit risk including: (a) information about the activity, region, or economic characteristics identifying a concentration, (b) the maximum amount of loss the entity is exposed to based on the gross fair value of the related item, (c) policy for requiring collateral or other security and information as to accessing such collateral or security, and (d) the nature and brief description of such collateral or security; (4) quantitative information about market risks and how such risks are managed; (5) for items measured on both a recurring and nonrecurring basis information regarding the inputs used to develop the fair value measurement; and (6) for items presented in the financial statement for which fair value measurement is elected: (a) information necessary to understand the reasons for the election, (b) discussion of the effect of fair value changes on earnings, (c) a description of [similar groups] items for which the election is made and the relation thereof to the balance sheet, the aggregate carrying value of items included in the balance sheet that are not eligible for the election; (7) all other required (as defined) and desired information.

role.label: Fair Value, Inputs, Level 2 [Member]
role.documentation: Inputs other than quoted prices included within level 1 that are observable for an asset or liability, either directly or indirectly, including, but not limited to, quoted prices for similar assets or liabilities in active markets, or quoted prices for identical or similar assets or liabilities in inactive markets.

role.label: Fair Value, Inputs, Level 3 [Member]
role.documentation: Unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

role.terseLabel: Fair Value, Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Input Reconciliation, Calculation [Roll Forward]
role.label: Fair Value, Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Input Reconciliation, Calculation [Roll Forward]
role.documentation: A roll forward is a reconciliation of a concept from the beginning of a period to the end of a period.

role.terseLabel: Fair Value, Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Input Reconciliation [Line Items]
role.label: Fair Value, Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Input Reconciliation [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.terseLabel: Fair Value, Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Input Reconciliation [Table]
role.label: Fair Value, Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Input Reconciliation [Table]
role.documentation: Disclosure of information about financial instrument liability measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input.

role.terseLabel: Summary of Changes in Fair Value
role.label: Fair Value, Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Input Reconciliation [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of the fair value measurement of liabilities using significant unobservable inputs (Level 3), a reconciliation of the beginning and ending balances, separately presenting changes attributable to the following: (1) total gains or losses for the period (realized and unrealized), segregating those gains or losses included in earnings (or changes in net assets), and gains or losses recognized in other comprehensive income (loss) and a description of where those gains or losses included in earnings (or changes in net assets) are reported in the statement of income (or activities); (2) purchases, sales, issues, and settlements (each type disclosed separately); and (3) transfers in and transfers out of Level 3 (for example, transfers due to changes in the observability of significant inputs) by class of liability.

role.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Gain (Loss) Included in Earnings
role.documentation: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in income from liability measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

role.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability Value
role.documentation: Fair value of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

role.label: Fair Value Hierarchy and NAV [Domain]
role.documentation: Categories used to prioritize the inputs to valuation techniques to measure fair value.

role.label: Finance Lease, Interest Expense
role.documentation: Amount of interest expense on finance lease liability.

role.terseLabel: Operating cash flows from finance leases
role.label: Finance Lease, Interest Payment on Liability
role.documentation: Amount of interest paid on finance lease liability.

role.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Fiscal Year Maturity [Abstract]
Finance Lease, Liability
role.documentation: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease.

role.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Current
role.documentation: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease, classified as current.

role.terseLabel: Schedule of Finance Lease Future Lease Payments
role.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Maturity [Table Text Block]
role.documentation: Tabular disclosure of undiscounted cash flows of finance lease liability. Includes, but is not limited to, reconciliation of undiscounted cash flows to finance lease liability recognized in statement of financial position.

role.terseLabel: Finance lease obligations, net of current portion
role.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Noncurrent
role.documentation: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease, classified as noncurrent.

role.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid
role.documentation: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease.

role.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, after Year Five
role.documentation: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year One
role.documentation: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Five
role.documentation: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Four
role.documentation: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Three
role.documentation: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Two
role.documentation: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Undiscounted Excess Amount
role.documentation: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments in excess of discounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease.

role.verboseLabel: Financing cash flows from finance leases
role.label: Finance Lease, Principal Payments
role.documentation: Amount of cash outflow for principal payment on finance lease.

role.label: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, Amortization
role.documentation: Amount of amortization expense attributable to right-of-use asset from finance lease.

role.label: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, before Accumulated Amortization
role.documentation: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of right-of-use asset from finance lease.

role.label: Finance Lease, Weighted Average Discount Rate, Percent
role.documentation: Weighted average discount rate for finance lease calculated at point in time.

role.label: Finance Lease, Weighted Average Remaining Lease Term
role.documentation: Weighted average remaining lease term for finance lease, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

role.label: Financial Instrument [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by type of financial instrument.

role.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Useful Life
role.documentation: Useful life of finite-lived intangible assets, in 'PnYnMnDTnHnMnS' format, for example, 'P1Y5M13D' represents the reported fact of one year, five months, and thirteen days.

role.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Accumulated Amortization
role.documentation: Accumulated amount of amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

role.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, after Year Five
role.documentation: Amount of amortization for asset, excluding financial asset and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year One
role.documentation: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Five
role.documentation: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Four
role.documentation: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Three
role.documentation: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Two
role.documentation: Amount of amortization for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with finite life expected to be recognized in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

role.terseLabel: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets by Major Class [Axis]
role.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets by Major Class [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by major type or class of finite-lived intangible assets.

role.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Gross
role.documentation: Amount before amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

role.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets [Line Items]
role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.terseLabel: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Major Class Name [Domain]
role.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Major Class Name [Domain]
role.documentation: The major class of finite-lived intangible asset (for example, patents, trademarks, copyrights, etc.) A major class is composed of intangible assets that can be grouped together because they are similar, either by their nature or by their use in the operations of a company.

role.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Net
role.documentation: Amount after amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.

role.label: FlexSteel [Member]
role.documentation: FlexSteel

role.label: Foreign Tax Jurisdiction [Member]
role.documentation: Designated foreign jurisdiction entitled to levy and collect income tax outside country of domicile.

role.label: Foreign Currency Transactions and Translations Policy [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for (1) transactions denominated in a currency other than the reporting enterprise's functional currency, (2) translating foreign currency financial statements that are incorporated into the financial statements of the reporting enterprise by consolidation, combination, or the equity method of accounting, and (3) remeasurement of the financial statements of a foreign reporting enterprise in a hyperinflationary economy.

role.terseLabel: Forgone Recovery due to Disqualification of Tax Benefits, Amount
role.label: Forgone Recovery due to Disqualification of Tax Benefits, Amount

role.terseLabel: Forgone Recovery due to Expense of Enforcement, Amount
role.label: Forgone Recovery due to Expense of Enforcement, Amount

role.label: Forgone Recovery due to Violation of Home Country Law, Amount
Forgone Recovery, Explanation of Impracticability [Text Block]

role.terseLabel: Prior Year End Fair Value of Equity Awards Granted in Any Prior Year that Fail to Meet Applicable Vesting Conditions During Covered Year
role.label: Prior Year End Fair Value of Equity Awards Granted in Any Prior Year that Fail to Meet Applicable Vesting Conditions During Covered Year [Member]
Furniture and Fixtures [Member]
role.documentation: Equipment commonly used in offices and stores that have no permanent connection to the structure of a building or utilities. Examples include, but are not limited to, desks, chairs, tables, and bookcases.

role.terseLabel: Gain (loss) on change in TRA liability
role.label: Gain (Loss) On Change In tax Receivable Agreement Liability
role.documentation: The amount of gain or (loss) arising due to change in tax receivable agreement.

role.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Assets
role.documentation: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of assets, including but not limited to property plant and equipment, intangible assets and equity in securities of subsidiaries or equity method investee.

role.label: Geographic Concentration Risk [Member]
role.documentation: Reflects the percentage that a specified dollar value on the balance sheet or income statement in the period from one or more specified geographic areas is to a corresponding consolidated, segment, or product line amount. Risk is the materially adverse effects of economic decline or antagonistic political actions resulting in loss of assets, sales volume, labor supply, or source of materials and supplies in a US state or a specified country, continent, or region such as EMEA (Europe, Middle East, Africa).

role.label: Geographic Distribution [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by geographic distribution of business activity identified as either domestic or foreign. Excludes names of countries, states and provinces, and cities.

role.label: Geographic Distribution [Domain]
role.documentation: Allocation of business activity identified as domestic or foreign. Excludes names of countries, states and provinces, and cities.

role.label: Geographic Distribution, Domestic [Member]
role.documentation: Allocation of business activity identified as domestic.

role.label: Goodwill
role.documentation: Amount, after accumulated impairment loss, of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

role.label: Goodwill and Intangible Assets Disclosure [Text Block]
role.documentation: The entire disclosure for goodwill and intangible assets.

role.label: Goodwill and Intangible Assets, Goodwill, Policy [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for goodwill. This accounting policy also may address how an entity assesses and measures impairment of goodwill, how reporting units are determined, how goodwill is allocated to such units, and how the fair values of the reporting units are determined.

role.label: Goodwill, Impairment Loss
role.documentation: Amount of impairment loss from asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

role.label: Identifiable Intangible Assets Acquired [Member]
role.documentation: Identifiable Intangible Assets Acquired

role.label: Impairment, Long-Lived Asset, Held-for-Use
role.documentation: The aggregate amount of write-downs for impairments recognized during the period for long lived assets held for use (including those held for disposal by means other than sale).

role.label: Impairment or Disposal of Long-Lived Assets, Policy [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for recognizing and measuring the impairment of long-lived assets. An entity also may disclose its accounting policy for long-lived assets to be sold. This policy excludes goodwill and intangible assets.

role.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Domestic
role.documentation: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to domestic operations.

role.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
role.documentation: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

role.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Foreign
role.documentation: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to foreign operations, which is defined as Income or Loss generated from operations located outside the entity's country of domicile.

role.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
role.documentation: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations including portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

role.label: Income Tax Jurisdiction [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by income tax jurisdiction.

role.label: Income Tax Jurisdiction [Domain]
role.documentation: Income tax jurisdiction.

role.label: Income Tax Disclosure [Text Block]
role.documentation: The entire disclosure for income tax.

role.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
role.documentation: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

role.terseLabel: Tax expense associated with revaluation of deferred tax asset
role.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations, Adjustment of Deferred Tax (Asset) Liability
role.documentation: Amount of income tax expense (benefit) from continuing operations attributable to an adjustment of a deferred tax liability or asset for enacted changes in tax laws or rates or a change in the tax status of the entity.

role.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Amount [Abstract]
Income Tax Paid, Federal, after Refund Received
role.documentation: Amount, after income tax refund received, of cash paid to federal (national) tax jurisdiction for tax on income.

role.label: Income Tax Paid, Foreign, after Refund Received
role.documentation: Amount, after income tax refund received, of cash paid to foreign tax jurisdiction for tax on income.

role.label: Income Tax Paid, State and Local, after Refund Received
role.documentation: Amount, after income tax refund received, of cash paid to state and local tax jurisdictions for tax on income.

role.label: Income Tax, Policy [Policy Text Block]
role.documentation: Disclosure of accounting policy for income taxes, which may include its accounting policies for recognizing and measuring deferred tax assets and liabilities and related valuation allowances, recognizing investment tax credits, operating loss carryforwards, tax credit carryforwards, and other carryforwards, methodologies for determining its effective income tax rate and the characterization of interest and penalties in the financial statements.

role.negatedTerseLabel: Tax benefit for release of valuation allowance
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Deferred Tax Assets Valuation Allowance, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in the valuation allowance for deferred tax assets.

role.terseLabel: Foreign income taxes (net of foreign tax credit)
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Foreign Income Tax Rate Differential, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign income tax expense (benefit).

role.label: Income Tax Reconciliation Foreign Withholding Tax
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pre-tax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign withholding taxes.

role.verboseLabel: Income taxes at 21% statutory tax rate
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Amount
role.documentation: The amount of income tax expense or benefit for the period computed by applying the domestic federal statutory tax rates to pretax income from continuing operations.

role.negatedLabel: Profit of non-controlling interest not subject to U.S. federal tax
role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Noncontrolling Interest Income (Loss), Amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to noncontrolling interest income (loss) exempt from income taxes.

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Other, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other nondeductible expenses.

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of reported income tax expense (benefit) in excess of (less than) expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to nondeductible expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. Includes, but is not limited to, expense determined to be nondeductible upon grant or after for award under share-based payment arrangement.

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Other Adjustments, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other adjustments.

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Other Reconciling Items, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation attributable to other reconciling item. Excludes state and local income tax expense (benefit), federal tax expense (benefit), statutory income tax expense (benefit) outside of country of domicile, tax credit, nondeductible expense, deduction, income tax settlement, income tax contingency, and cross-border tax law.

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Prior Year Income Taxes, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to revisions of previously reported income tax expense (benefit).

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, State and Local Income Taxes, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to state and local income tax expense (benefit).

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Foreign, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign tax credit.

role.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Other, Amount
role.documentation: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other tax credits.

role.terseLabel: Cash paid for income taxes, net of refunds
role.label: Income Taxes Paid
role.documentation: Amount, before refund, of cash paid to foreign, federal, state, and local jurisdictions as income tax.
